test_title: PYST 28: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Mr. Adhil __called back but he wasn’t able to__ find the scooter part he needed.

options.text: called down but he wasn’t able to
called off but he wasn’t able to
called around but he wasn’t able to
called up to but he wasn’t able to

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The phrase "called around" means to make a series of phone calls to different places or people in order to find or obtain something.
 
• This phrase fits the context, as Mr. Adhil was trying to find a scooter part and likely made multiple calls to do so.

Therefore, the correct substitution is **called around but he wasn’t able to**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mr. Adhil called around but he wasn’t able to find the scooter part he needed."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: "called down but he wasn’t able to"** – "Called down" is not appropriate in this context.
 
• **Option 2: "called off but he wasn’t able to"** – "Called off" means to cancel, which does not fit the context.
 
• **Option 4: "called up to but he wasn’t able to"** – "Called up to" is not idiomatic or appropriate here.
